name: Chen
source:
He is the executive of the Web.
He is the second oldest executive after Song An, and the one who proposed the system of the Web assassin school.
He mainly deals with clients related to underworld organizations in the Kowloon area.
At Song An's request, he lent Lycoris to Xin Guang, but brought her back because she was treated as a sex doll.
He seemed to be concerned about this and ordered Jack and Yuchi to investigate the whereabouts of Lycoris when she escaped, and he also provided false evidence in defense of Lycoris during the purge of Xin Guang.
He also once managed Luk.
